turnos.mensaje: How long does standard shipping usually take?

Standard shipping usually takes 2 to 4 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders of $75 or more qualify for free shipping. Please note that Nerds Store does not offer international shipping.
Okay, thanks! So if I order something under $75, do I still have to pay for express shipping, or is there a cheaper option?

The knowledge base doesn't list shipping fees for standard or express options, so I can't confirm the exact cost for orders under $75. What I can confirm is that orders of $75 or more qualify for free shipping, and standard shipping is the option that takes 2 to 4 business days. For the shipping costs, please contact support@nerdsstore.example.
Got it, thanks. Do you guys ship to Canada, or is it domestic only?
Nerds Store does not offer international shipping, so we don't ship to Canada. Orders are domestic only. For further questions, you can contact support@nerdsstore.example.
Thanks, that clears it up. Last question: if I end up ordering from the US but have it shipped to a friend's address, is that still fine as long as it's within the country?

The knowledge base doesn't include a policy on shipping to a different address than the buyer's. It only states that Nerds Store doesn't offer international shipping, so domestic shipping is available. For confirmation about shipping to a friend's address, please contact support@nerdsstore.example.
Thanks, that helps! Just one more: is there a way to track my order once it ships?
Yes. Tracking information becomes available once a carrier has been assigned to your order. If you share your order ID, I can check its current tracking status for you.
Perfect, that's all I needed. Thanks so much for the help!
You're welcome! Enjoy your purchase, and feel free to reach out anytime.
